items.headline: Two Burlington roads will stay fully closed into September.
items.deck: Spruce Avenue is closed through Sept. 4. Britannia Road has no through traffic through the end of September.
items.label: Roads
items.alt: Road construction and lane restrictions on a Burlington arterial road.
items.storyGoal: Give Burlington residents a concise, verified list of significant full municipal road closures that continue into September, while separating them from ordinary lane restrictions.

items.headline: Burlington's proposed data centre is not what many people think.
items.deck: The City says it is not an AI hyperscale campus. The bigger question is what 20 megawatts means for the neighbourhood beside it.
